articles.title: More women likely to come forward, says detective who led Russell Brand investigation
articles.description: Det Supt Andy Furphy said he hoped other potential victims would gain "courage" and "confidence" from the guilty verdicts.

articles.title: Married at First Sight UK cancelled after BBC revealed rape allegations
articles.description: Three women made allegations about the men they were partnered with. Channel 4 has apologised and said the show's budget would be reinvested  in "distinctive new programming".

articles.title: Watch: Was an Italian chef really fired over refusal to put pineapple on pizza?
articles.description: The chef had stated that putting pineapple on pizza was "offensive to his culture".

articles.title: A bitter end for Ronaldo - the icon who transformed Portugal announces international retirement
articles.description: As Cristiano Ronaldo retires from international football, Guillem Balague looks at why and what is next for the Portugal legend.
